model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates block-wise “Sensitivity” values across a sequence of transformer block indices, with bars colored by two quantization settings shown in the legend (blue: “8-Fbit”, green: “4-Fbit”). The x-axis is labeled “Block Index” on a linear scale spanning 0 to 31, with labeled ticks at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 31. The y-axis is labeled “Sensitivity” on a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels at approximately \(10^{-6}\), \(10^{-5}\), and \(10^{-4}\). For block indices 0 through 21, the bars are green (4-Fbit) and generally range from just under \(10^{-6}\) to several \(\times 10^{-6}\): around index 0 the bar is near \(1\times 10^{-6}\), there is a visible dip around index 8 to below \(1\times 10^{-6}\) (roughly \(6\times 10^{-7}\)), and by the mid-to-late teens the bars rise to a few \(\times 10^{-6}\), reaching roughly \(5\text{–}7\times 10^{-6}\) around indices 17–21. For block indices 22 through 31, the bars are blue (8-Fbit) and start around the upper \(10^{-6}\) range (approximately \(7\text{–}8\times 10^{-6}\) near indices 22–23), increase to about \(1\times 10^{-5}\) around indices 24–25, continue upward through the \(10^{-5}\) range across indices 26–29 (roughly \(1.3\times 10^{-5}\) to \(2\text{–}3\times 10^{-5}\)), and then rise sharply for the final blocks, with index 30 near the mid-\(10^{-5}\) range (around \(4\text{–}5\times 10^{-5}\)) and index 31 approaching \(10^{-4}\) (roughly \(8\times 10^{-5}\)).
